findings.fact: Pinned 735B/ecd66dca… but the committed blob is 720B/f199a668…. Reviewer reconstruction: replacing LF by CRLF in the blob gives exactly 735B/ecd66dca…, so the pin is of the pre-commit CRLF PowerShell file and repository eol=lf normalisation changed the bytes. Content is identical; the other 40 inventory entries match byte-exactly.
findings.disposition: Root should note the normalisation (or re-pin the committed LF bytes) in its next checkpoint. Not a tampering indication and not a product defect.

findings.fact: The published node-start program is a template containing the PC3 address 192.168.45.222 twice (publish flag and PortBindings assertion). The PC2/PC4 receipts show 192.168.45.143/.210, so the bytes actually executed on PC2/PC4 differ from the published file and are neither published nor hashed. The recorded docker inspect results (asserted by the same program shape) bind the actual configuration.
findings.disposition: Root should record the rendering rule (only that address literal substituted) and the SHA256 of each rendered PC2/PC4 program, or publish them. Non-blocking for observation acceptance.

findings.fact: The observer runs /observer-bootstrap.py (SHA 8cccc5a1…) built by Dockerfile r2 (260f52d7…); neither file's bytes are public. Source inv.observer_worker.main reads INV_RUNTIME_DSN from the environment, so a bootstrap must read the secret file and enter the standard main. 'Standard observer, no custom poll loop' is therefore Root-attested; the reviewer can confirm only that the observed cadence and probe counts are consistent with the source loop.
findings.disposition: Root should publish the bootstrap and Dockerfile r2 bytes (no secret content) or an AST summary pinned to those SHAs before treating the observer image as a reviewed standard deployment beyond this pilot.

findings.fact: The CLI inserts Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'services/control-plane/src' at sys.path[0]. For the copied ops/fresh_cpu_admission.py that is <share>/services/control-plane/src on the PC3 operator host. findings.disposition: Before further CLI use, Root should record read-only absence of <share>/services/control-plane/src (or invoke the library via a pinned entry that adds no path). No product change required for this acceptance.
